title: MHADA Pune lottery: tomorrow, 22 October, is the last day to apply and pay the deposit
audience: Marathi families in Pune and PCMC applying for the MHADA Pune lottery 2026 (EWS/LIG, first home) who have not finished the application, 22-50
message: Tomorrow, 22 October 11:59 pm, is the last date to apply and pay the deposit online (RTGS/NEFT by 23 October 3:59 pm); finish today, the site gets slow on the last night; apply only on MHADA's official site.
facts: The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm (23:59). Source: MHADA Pune board, extension of 14 October 2026.
Deposit paid by RTGS or NEFT from a bank is accepted until 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm (15:59). Source: MHADA Pune board.
The application is complete only after the deposit (EMD) is paid: 15,000 for EWS, 20,000 for LIG, plus the 708 application fee.
Keep the payment receipt; the application status shows on the applicant's dashboard on MHADA's official site.
The draw is planned for 4 December 2026.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; nobody needs to be paid to apply.

hook: MHADA पुणे लॉटरी: उद्या, 22 ऑक्टोबर, शेवटचा दिवस
caption:
MHADA Pune Lottery 2026 last date tomorrow | म्हाडा पुणे सोडत: उद्या शेवटचा दिवस

📅 अर्ज आणि अनामत रक्कम (EMD): 22 ऑक्टोबर, रात्री 11:59 पर्यंत

🌐 अधिकृत साइट: https://housing.mhada.gov.in/
⚠️ अर्ज फक्त अधिकृत साइटवर करा. अर्जासाठी कोणालाही पैसे देऊ नका.

व्हिडिओतील चित्रे MHADA लॉटरी पोर्टलवरील आहेत.

reply_facts: The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm; RTGS/NEFT payment by 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm.

The application is complete only after the deposit (EMD) is paid: 15,000 for EWS, 20,000 for LIG, plus the 708 application fee. Keep the receipt; the status shows on your dashboard on MHADA's official site.
The draw is planned for 4 December 2026.
The homes in this lottery are located in Pune city, Pimpri-Chinchwad and the PMRDA area only.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; Avasetu does not take applications or money.
The pictures in the reel are screenshots of MHADA's lottery portal.

reply_faq.q: Will the date be extended again, mudatvadh?
reply_faq.a: No further extension had been announced when this was posted; the last date is 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm. If MHADA changes it, we will post it straight away.

reply_faq.q: I applied but did not pay, is my application valid?
reply_faq.a: The application is complete only after the deposit (EMD) is paid. Pay by 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm online, or by RTGS/NEFT so that it reaches by 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm.

reply_faq.q: How do I check my application status or payment?
reply_faq.a: Log in on MHADA's official housing site with the username you made when you registered; your application and its status show on your dashboard. Keep the receipt you got after paying.
